overclaims.statement: As of March 6, 2024, Fowler served as Deputy Coordinator for Diplomacy for the global Feed the Future initiative, leading the diplomatic agenda for global food security development efforts.
overclaims.citedQuote: Special Envoy for Global Food Security Dr. Cary Fowler
overclaims.rationale: The 'leading the diplomatic agenda' portion rests solely on Fowler's own first-person testimony (sourceClass self-report); the dossier presents it as an established role description without independent corroboration. Uncertain because self-testimony before the Senate Foreign Relations Committee is a reasonably strong source for one's own title and duties.

judgements.referenceQuote: As the Deputy Coordinator for Diplomacy for the global Feed the Future initiative, I lead the diplomatic agenda for our global food security development efforts.
judgements.evidenceQuote: as of March 6, 2024, served as Deputy Coordinator for Diplomacy for the global Feed the Future initiative, leading the diplomatic agenda for global food security development efforts
judgements.rationale: The dossier states the same fact including the March 6, 2024 date and the diplomatic agenda role, matching the reference statement.

usefulness.rationale: The dossier correctly identifies Cary Fowler via solid identity anchors (Special Envoy for Global Food Security 2022–2025, Svalbard Seed Vault/Crop Trust, 2024 World Food Prize), but its substantive content is a single career claim drawn from one March 2024 Senate testimony. A reader learns his title and self-described Feed the Future role but almost nothing about his actual accomplishments (seed vault work, Crop Trust, World Food Prize are anchors only, with no supporting passages). The dossier does not explicitly flag gaps, though the thinness is visible. Not sufficient to prepare for a meeting: no details on his priorities, positions, speaking style, or current status after the envoy role ended in January 2025.
